items.name: Kaggriculture-Greedy-Optimizer-Staged-Frozen-RL
items.description: Kaggle Kaggriculture competition agent combining a closed-form capital optimizer with 8 staged REINFORCE/PPO controllers. Each controller manages one economic decision and is frozen before the next stage. The system uses local per-decision rewards and benchmarks the trained stack against a heuristic baseline.
